      Travel to Netherlands

      Experience the Vibrant Charm and Scenic Beauty of the Netherlands with Saudia Airlines

      Discover a land where historic artistry meets modern innovation. From the shimmering canal rings of Amsterdam to the sprawling flower fields of the countryside, the Netherlands invites you to explore its unique heritage and breathtaking landscapes. Fly with Saudia to begin your Dutch adventure with world class comfort and authentic hospitality.


      1. Cruise Historic Canal Rings

      Glide through the heart of Amsterdam on a peaceful boat tour. Admire the elegant 17th century merchant houses and iconic stone bridges that create a shimmering reflection on the water.


      2. Explore Iconic Windmill Villages

      Step back in time at Zaanse Schans to witness the rhythmic sails of traditional windmills. Discover the craftsmanship behind these historic structures as they paint a picturesque silhouette against the sky.


      3. Wander Through Vibrant Tulip Fields

      Immerse yourself in a kaleidoscope of color across the Dutch countryside. Visit during the spring to walk among millions of blooming tulips that create a fragrant and stunning natural tapestry.


      4. Cycle Scenic Countryside Paths

      Pedal through lush meadows and past quiet waterways on the country's famous cycling routes. Experience the freedom of the open road as you discover hidden gems at your own pace.


      5. Discover World Class Art Museums

      Behold the masterpieces of Rembrandt and Van Gogh in the prestigious halls of the Rijksmuseum. Explore centuries of creative genius and the rich cultural legacy of the Dutch masters.


      6. Savor Traditional Dutch Earthenware Crafting

      Visit Delft to see the intricate process of creating world famous blue and white pottery. Watch skilled artisans hand paint delicate designs that have defined Dutch elegance for generations.


      7. Taste Authentic Local Cheese Varieties

      Indulge your palate with a visit to a local farm or cheese market. From creamy Gouda to sharp Edam, discover why the Netherlands is a global leader in artisanal dairy traditions.


      8. Experience Coastal Beach Culture

      Relax on the expansive sandy shores of Scheveningen or Zandvoort. Enjoy the refreshing North Sea breeze and the lively atmosphere of stylish beach clubs and seaside promenades.


      9. Visit Grand Medieval Castles

      Uncover the legends of Muiderslot or De Haar Castle. Wander through manicured gardens and soaring towers that offer a glimpse into the regal history and architectural splendor of the past.


      10. Enjoy Lively Street Side Cafe Terraces

      Sip a coffee and watch the world go by from a cozy "brown cafe" or a modern terrace. Embrace the local spirit of "gezelligheid" as you soak in the friendly energy of Dutch city life.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Netherlands

      1. Amsterdam

      Cruise through iconic canals and admire the leaning gabled houses that define this historic capital. Explore world-class culture at the Rijksmuseum or lose yourself in the charming streets of the Jordaan district. Experience the perfect blend of heritage and creative energy in a city that truly never ceases to inspire.
